25)༄༅/zab lam bla ma'i sgrub pa dngos grub rgya mtsho'i sprin phung bzhugs/26)rgyal kun spyi gzugs mtsho skyes rjer/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal

tei:div.tei:p: 25) ༄༅/ zab lam bla ma'i sgrub pa dngos grub rgya mtsho'i sprin phung bzhugs/ 26)

rgyal kun spyi gzugs mtsho skyes rjer// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// zab lam bla ma sgrub pa'i tshul// dbye la mkha' 'gros gnang ba stsol// de la mchog thun 'dod rgu'i dngos grub yid bzhin du sgrub par 'dod pas/ lam 'dir 'jug par bya ste/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// deng bzung byang chub ma thob bar// mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /sems bskyed pa ni/ mar gyur mtha' yas sems can rnams// sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i phyir// gsang chen zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas// don gnyis sgrub par sems bskyed do/ /yan lag bdun pa na ི/ skyabs yul rtsa gsum lha tshogs la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin 'bul// tshe rabs sdig ltung mthol zhing bshags// dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang*// zab rgyas chos 'khor skor bar skul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /bgegs gtor gtong ba ni/ hūm̐/ gsang chen sngags kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir// 'du bar mi dbang gdon 27) bgegs rigs// gtor ma longs la gzhan du dengs// bka' 'das rdul phran bzhin du brlag oṃ sum bha ni= sogs drag sngags dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor sgom pa ni/ hūm̐/ phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud lha// phyi rol rdo rje'i srung ba'i gur// sra mkhregs rab tu brtan pa yi// gzhom med ya lad btsan por gyur// badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings spros bral ngang nyid las// ma 'gags thugs rje'-i sgyu 'phrul gar// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang skur// mtshan dpe'i gzi byin ya la la// tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs 'u ru ru// mkhyen brtse'i dgongs pa lam se lam// gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang skur// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// sgrub pa'i rdzas la byin chen phob// rnal 'byor sems la bde chen skyed// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhā+e ba ḍāk+ki ni sarba sa ma ya a be sha ya a a/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snod bcud brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun// mchod 28) sprin bsam yas lhun grub pa// rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings 'geng ba// zad med nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= shab+da sarba pañtsa rak+ta ba ling+ta ma hā su kha pū dza āḥhūm̐/ rten dang brten pa'i lha skyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'khor 'das chos rnams gdod ma nas// dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med cing*// spros pa kun bral de bzhin nyid// ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can la// tshad med snying rje kun tu snang*// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug pa'i// rgyu yi ting 'dzin hrīḥdakar po// de las 'od zer kun tu 'phro/ e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ sum̐ ram̐ bh+rum̐// e las nam mkha' yaṃ las rlung*// bam̐ las rgya mtsho laṃ las sa// sum̐ las ri rab bang rim gzhir// ram̐ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar// de dbus bh+rum̐ yig yongs gyur las// thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs can// tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs// 'dab stong chu skyes bzhed pa'i steng*// dri med zla ba rgyas pa'i dbus// rgyu yi sa bon hrīḥyig babs// spro bsdus yongs su gyur pa las// bdag nyid rgyal kun spyi gzugs che// dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma 29) skyes// dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags shing*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ma khro// zhal 'dzum spyan hur dgyes pa'i nyams// phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsdigs// g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum 'dzin/ gru mor khā ṭ+waṃ dkur brten zhing*// sku la gsang gos dkar po dang*// mthing nag ber chen chos gos dmar// dbang gi zab ber dmar smug brjid// 'dab ldan rigs lnga'i mnyen zhu gsol// rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su 'gying*// 'ja' zer 'od phung klong na bzhugs// g.yas su lha lcam man+da ra// sna lnga'i mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin// g.yon du mtsho rgyal pad+ma'i lcam// zag med bdud rtsi'i thod phor bsnams// gnyis ka dar dang rin chen rgyan/

phyi 'khor pad+ma'i 'dab ma la// bud+dha thod phreng dmar smug brjid// badz+ra thod phreng dkar gsal mdzes// rat+na thod phreng ser gsal rngams// pad+ma thod phreng dmar gsal sgeg /karma thod phreng mthing nag gtum// sde lnga g.yas pas ḍā ru la// rang rtags mtshan pa'i dril bu g.yon// de rgyab pad+ma'i 'dab 'khor la/ pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum mthing*/ 30) rdor dril 'dzin zhing longs spyod chas// pad+ma saṃ bha dkar dmar mdangs/ pad phor skyabs sbyin rab byung tshul// blo ldan mchog sred dkar gsal 'dzum// ḍā ru pad phor sngags 'chang chas// pad+ma rgyal po dmar la sgeg /nyi ma 'od zer gser gyi mdog /kha ṭ+waṃ nyi zer rnal 'byor spyod// shākya seng ge sku mdog ser// rdo rje lhung bzed sprul sku'i tshul// seng ge sgra sgrog mthing nag rngams// rdo rje sdigs mdzub khro bo'i chas// rdo rje gro lod dmar smug brjid// rdo rje phur pa gtum drag rngams// phyi 'khor rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bcu drug dang*// sgo bzhir ging chen sde bzhi gsal/ khor yug rgya bod rig 'dzin dang*// rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lha// ma mgon dam can gter srung sogs// nyi las 'od zer bzhin du shar// rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// snang stong zung 'jug chu zla'am// 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar gyur// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer bsam// de las 'od zer mkha' khyab spros// rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo nas// bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sa mā dza/ de nas 31) spyan 'dren pa ni/ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// pad+ma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ khyod kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi// byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol/

gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ gzhal yas pho brang nyams dga' 'dir// sgrub mchog byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir// lha tshogs ma lus 'khor dang bcas// mi g.yo dgyes par bzhugs su gsol/ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung rang shar dkyil 'khor lhar/ bzang ngan gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i ngang*/ blang dor med pa'i brda phyag gar// 'du 'bral med par phyag bgyi'o/ a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ 32) me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// sman gtor rak+ta mchod pa'i sprin// bde chen dpal ster lha mo'i tshogs// dkyil 'khor lha la dgyes mchod 'bul// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= shab+da/ ru pa shab+da ghan+dhe rā sa spar+she sarba pañtsa rak+ta ba ling+ta ma hā su kha pū dza hoḥ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku// bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje// pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nyid las// zag med bde ba'i dpal ster shes rab ma// bcu drug dga' ba'i lang tsho mchog tu rgyas// man+dha ra ba mkhar chen bza' la bstod// bde chen ye shes lnga yi rol gar la// lhun grub nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje 'gags med rtag khyab lhun grub kyi// gu ru thod phreng sde lnga'i sku la bstod// tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas su dag pa las// dur khrod brgyad du dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin// rnam 'phrul 'gags med sgyu ma'i cho rol ston// sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad la bstod// chos nyid

33) gcig la ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul// ma 'gags gang 'dul bsam yas 'khor lo'i sprin// rig 'dzin yi dam 'kha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bzlas dmigs ni/ thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*/ ye shes sems dpa' 'od mtha' yas// dmar gsal tshe bum longs sku'i chas// rang 'dra'i yum dang mnyam sbyor ba'i// thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i// lte bar thugs srog hrīḥyi mthar// sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las// 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod// byin rlabs dngos grub bdag la bsdu// 'gro ba'i las nyon sdig sgrib sbyang*// kun kyang lha sngags chos sku'i ngang*// ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom// ma grub bar du m-i gtang ngo*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ bsnyen pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bzla/ skabs su tshe sgrub dmigs bzlas bya bar spro na / sngags las 'od 'phros snod bcud khyab// brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud ma lus bsdus// sems dpa' stang dpyal sku la thim// yab yum sbyor ba'i byang sems rgyun// shel gong 'o mas gang ba ltar/ 34) /lus kyi nang kun khyab par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi a yu she hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ tshe 'gugs ni/ hūm̐/ rang snang rnam dag rnga yab zhing*// zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang na// 'chi med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// tshe sbyin bde ba'i dpal ster ma// thod phreng sde lnga mtshan mchog brgyad// rig 'dzin yi dam 'kha' 'gro dang*// ma mgon dam can gter srung tshogs// thugs dam bskul lo mthu byin skyed// bla tshe chad nyams yar ba kun// 'ja' zer thig le'i rnam par sdus// sgrub mchog bdag la tshe dbang skur// 'chi med gnyug ma rdo rje'i dbyings// 'gyur med tshe yi dpal thob shog sngags brjod/ tshe sba ba ni/ āḥ 'khor 'das kun tu 'khyams pa'i tshe// chos dbyings klong du rgyas gdab pas// 'gyur ba med pa'i tshe thob nas// skye 'chi med pa'i don rtogs shog

dharmā dha tu badz+ra rak+ṣaḥ rjes la tshogs kyi rim pa la 'jug na/ srid pa'i yo byad bza' btung gi dngos su bshams la/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros me rlung chus// tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin rnam rtog sbyangs// ye shes bdud rtsi chen por gyur/ 35) oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ka dag spros bral klong*// lhun grub 'od gsal 'ja' zer sbubs// zung 'jug gnyug ma rdo rje'i sku// 'chi med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtshor bcas// tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// tshogs khang rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing*// tshogs rdzas 'dod yon lha mo'i gar// mched lcam dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// rdo rje'i glu gar nyams re dga'// 'dod yon longs spyod brjid re che// nyams dang rtogs pa ban ma bun// 'dir gshegs tshogs la byin chen phob// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ mchod pa n-i/ hūm̐/ gsang sngags dam tshig bla na med// 'dod yon longs spyod phyi yi tshogs// a haṃ 'bar 'dzag nang gi tshogs// bde stong bla med gsang ba'i tshogs// 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ ghā na tsakra pū dza hoḥ bar gshags ni/ hūm̐/ tshe rabs thog med dus nyid nas// ma rig nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams pa// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags// badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ bsgral 36) bstabs ni/ e las srid pa'i brub khung nang*// ma rig bdag rtog gdon bgegs rnams// mtshan ma ming dang bcas pa gsal// 'gugs byed pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis// srid gsum 'byung bzhi'i gab bskungs phud// dmigs pa'i rten la myur du khug hūm̐/ bdag nyid pad+ma drag po rtsal// gtum drag rngams pa'i rang bzhin la// las byed pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs// mtshon cha sna tshogs char ltar 'bebs// phur pa sras mchog kī la ya// rno dbal ngar gyis gnod byed gzir// tshe bsod sgrub mchog bdag la thim// rnam shes rgyal ba'i sras su gyur// sha khrag tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol/

sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ maṃ sa rak+ta king ni ri ti khā hiḥ thugs dam bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ bde chen zhing mgon rigs kyi bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug snying rje'i gter// rdo rje'i sku brnyes mtsho skyes rje// pad+ma thod phreng thugs dam bskang*// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi'i ro// bcu drug dga' ba'i dbyings su bskyil// lha lcam me tog man+da ra// ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang*// dug lnga ma spangs rang sar grol// ye shes chen po'i sku ru smin// lhun grub nges pa 37)lnga ldan pa// thod phreng rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang*// tshogs brgyad ma 'gags lam me ba// snang yul 'dzin pa dbyings su yal// gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul drwa bar shar// mtshan mchog brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*// mchog thun grub gnyis 'dod rgu'i dbyig /mnga' dbang sgyur ba'i mtshan rtags can// gangs can grub brnyes slob dpon che// rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i thugs dam bskang*// bde stong bdud rtsi'i zil mngar gyis// mtshan rtog 'gyu ba klong du sgrol// bcu drug dga' ba'i ye shes che// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// byams chen tshad med thugs rje yis// 'gro ba thar pa'i lam du 'dren// 'gugs 'ching sdom myaus las byed pa// ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mtshod 'dzin cing*// grub gnyis dpal la mnga' dbang bsgyur// 'phags bod rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs// bye ba sa ya'i thugs dam bskang*/ bya spyod rnal 'byor bla na med// mdo sgyu sems klong man ngag sogs// rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lha// bsam yas 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ gnas yul nyer bzhi'i zhing rnams skyong*// thugs gsung sku yi 'khor lo yi/ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ 38) /zhing gi rdul snyed thugs dam bskang*// lha chen dpal 'bar ma ning nag /sngags srung e ka dza tri ma// skyes mchog dam can rdo rje legs// bka' srung dregs pa'i thugs dam bskang*// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma yis// bka' bsgos dam bzhag zab gter skyong*// brgyud gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// grangs med bsam yas thams cad dang*/

hūm̐/ thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni// nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// sman gtor rak+ta 'dod yon sprin// mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan bam// za le shel sgong tsa ra rog /gsang chen dam tshig rdzas rnams kyi// thugs dam bskang ngo dngos grub stsol// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rgyu ba chod// 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi klong du sod// gsang ba'i dgra gsumadabyings su non// bar chad 'phrang gsum thal bar rlogs// 'du ba gsum gyi rten 'brel sgrigs// 'bar ba gsum gyi ye shes kyi// lhan skyes mchog gi dngos grub stsol// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las// mig sman mkha' spyod ril bu sogs// thun mong rtsol med yid 39)bzhin 'grub// mthar thug rig stong gnyug ma'i dbyings// dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin pa dag /nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i klong*// mngon sangs rgyas pa'i bkra shis stsol/

brda dang brda len gyis tshogs la rol/ lhag ma gtong ba ni/ hūm̐/ gnas mchog nyer bzhi'i mkha' 'gro tshogs// lhag la dung zhing tshogs khang 'grim// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i drod nyul zhing*// dam tshig can la dngos grub ster// dam nyams rnams kyi tshe srog gcod// lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad srungs/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod// u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta khā hiḥ thugs dam skul ba ni/ hūm̐/ ma bcos chos dbyings zhing khams nas// rgyal ba kun gyi spyi mes che/ khyab bdag mgon po 'od mi 'gyur// thugs rje'i gter gcig spyan ras gzigs// dkyil 'khor khyab bdag pad+ma 'byung*// rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtshor bcas// chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la// mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa dang*// mtha' dmag 'byung po'i 'tshe ba srungs// nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zlog /rnal 'byor rtsa rlung nyams pa sol// sgrubs pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ chad tho 40) ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe bskal pa'i thog ma la// pad+ma kun tu 'chang chen gyis// dgongs brgyud sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs la// brjod med rang byung rdo rje'i rgyud// brda tshig bral bar bstan pa'i tshe// spang thob bral bar khas blangs bzhin// rang byung rig pa'i gtor ma longs// gzhi thog grol ba'i phrin las mdzod// de 'og bskal pa bar ma la// lha gnas gsum sogs sngags kyi zhing*// 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gis// brda brgyud rig 'dzin rgya mtsho la// gsang chen rgyud sde'i gnas bstan tshe// rdo rje theg pa'i bka' srung rnams// tha tshig rdo rje'i yal gam bzhin// dam tshig rgyan gyi mchod gtor longs/ dam bcas bzhin du phrin las mdzod// tha ma gangs can bod kyi yul// rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng gis/ snyan brgyud rje 'bangs las can la// smin grol zab mo'i sgo phyes te// zab gsang gter du sbas ba'i tshe// srid pa'i lha 'dre che dgu yis// srog snying phul te bro bor bzhin// mchod gtor rgyan ldan 'di bzhes la// las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/

brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐/ bod khams skyong ba'i yal gam can// ma mo brtan ma bcu gnyis rnams// 'dir byon gtor ma'i bshal chu bzhes// bcol pa'i 41) phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ bro mnan ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdud bgegs log 'drain dam sri kun// gtor gzhong ri rab 'og tu mnan// steng du lha tshogs bro brdung pas/ byang chub sems mchog ma skyes bar/ nam yang gtang bar mi bya'o/ oṃ lam/ āḥlam/ hūm̐ lam/ s+t+waṃ bha ya naṃ/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i zhag grangs them// dngos grub stsol ba'i dus lags pas// sku gsung thu+ugs dang dbang bcu'i stobs// da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol/ sngags mthar/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ nongs pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag sogs ma shes bag med pas// sgo gsum mi dge'i dbang gyur pas// cho ga lhag chad nor 'khrul kun// mthol lo bshags so tshangs par stsol/ yig brgya brjod/ bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐/ bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun// 'od gsal chen po'i klong du bsdu// zung 'jug sgyu ma'i lha skur ldang*// sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyis bsrung*/ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐/ bsngo smon ni/ 42) hoḥ 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge rtsa kun// mi gnas mya ngan 'das par bsngo// 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor ldog nas kyang*// phyam gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas par shog lan gsum/ bkra shis ni/ hoḥ gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu 'chang*// 'od mi 'gyur ba'i bkra shis shog /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs// 'jig rten dbang phyug bkra shis shog /rgyal kun spyi gzugs rig pa 'dzin// pad+ma thod phreng bkra shis shog /zag med bde ba'i dpal ster ba// dgyes mdzad ḍāki'i bkra shis shog /rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos// gang 'dul sprul pa'i 'khor lor shar// mtshan mchog brgyad kyi bkra shis shog

/grub gnyis 'dod rgu'i mnga' dbang sgyur// rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i bkra shis shog /gang la bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bkra shis shog zhes pa'ang sngags la mos pa lhag par brtas pa kun bzang pad+ma rdo rje nus ldan theg mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// maṅga laṃ//
